sn26.9:1.2: yo bhikkhave paṭhavīdhātuyā uppādo ṭhiti abhinibbatti pātubhāvo …pe… jarāmaraṇassa pātubhāvo
sn26.9:1.7: yo viññāṇadhātuyā uppādo ṭhiti abhinibbatti pātubhāvo dukkhasseso uppādo rogānaṃ ṭhiti jarāmaraṇassa pātubhāvo.
sn26.9:1.8: yo ca kho bhikkhave paṭhavīdhātuyā nirodho …pe… jarāmaraṇassa atthaṅgamo
sn26.9:1.13: yo viññāṇadhātuyā nirodho vūpasamo atthaṅgamo dukkhasseso nirodho rogānaṃ vūpasamo jarāmaraṇassa atthaṅgamoti.
